Before: a bowl of rice with chicken in curry sauce (~350 g, ~550 kcal), a salad with beans, cucumber, tomato and a creamy dressing (~150 g, ~150 kcal), and a chocolate bar in a wrapper (~40 g, ~200 kcal). The water is not counted.

After: the main dish is mostly eaten, with some sauce and a few chicken pieces left, so roughly 85% was eaten. The salad bowl holds only a little pink dressing, so about 90% was eaten. The bar wrapper is still there and looks open or empty, so the bar was probably eaten. I can't be sure of that, but I'll assume it was.

Main: 0.85 × 550 ≈ 470 kcal, 0.85 × 350 ≈ 300 g.
Salad: 0.9 × 150 ≈ 135 kcal, 0.9 × 150 ≈ 135 g.
Bar: about 200 kcal, 40 g.

Total ≈ 805 kcal and 475 g.
